items.title: 4.1.5.3 Task Scheduling using a Queue (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of task scheduling (PDF 104).

blocks.text: Queue se task scheduling (kaamon ki baari tay karna) samajhne ke liye doctor ke clinic ki misal lein.

items: Kaam mareezon jaise: computer ka har kaam (task) aisa hai jaise doctor ke paas aane wala mareez. Mareez clinic aa kar apni baari ka intezar karte hain; isi tarah kaam computer par aa kar process hone ka intezar karte hain.

Queue intezar ki list: computer ki queue clinic ki waiting list jaisi hai. Yeh kaamon ko usi order (tarteeb) mein yaad rakhti hai jis mein woh aaye, jaise list mareezon ka order rakhti hai. Is se kaam ek ek kar ke sahi order mein hote hain.

Enqueue: naya kaam aaye (maslan aap computer par "Print" dabayein) to woh queue ke aakhir mein jur jata hai, jaise naya mareez waiting list ke aakhir mein likha jata hai. Kaam ko queue mein jorne ko enqueue kehte hain.
Dequeue: jaise hi computer tayyar hota hai, woh queue ke sab se aage wala kaam nikal kar karta hai, jaise doctor agla mareez bulata hai. Kaam ko queue se nikalne ko dequeue kehte hain.

Queue kyun? Queue se kaam usi order mein hote hain jis mein aaye, aur koi kaam reh nahi jata; jaise har mareez apne aane ke order se doctor ko dikhata hai. Is se computer kaam efficiently (achhi tarah, kam waqt mein) aur fairly (sab ke saath barabar) karta hai.

blocks.text: Yeh program kaamon ko aane ke order mein (pehle aao, pehle pao) chalata hai aur batata hai ke har kaam kitni der intezar karta hai aur kab khatam hota hai. durations ki values ya tasks ka order badal kar Run karein.

tasks = ["Print report", "Save file", "Send email"]
durations = [3, 1, 2]   # seconds each task needs

for i in range(len(tasks)):              # first come, first served
    wait = sum(durations[:i])             # time of all tasks before this one
    print(tasks[i], "waits", wait, "s, finishes at", wait + durations[i], "s")
print("All tasks done at", sum(durations), "s")

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"tasks = [...]": 3 kaam jo aane ki tarteeb mein queue mein hain.
"durations = [3, 1, 2]": har kaam kitne second leta hai (usi tarteeb mein).
"for i in range(len(tasks)):": har kaam ka index 0, 1, 2 baari baari.
"wait = sum(durations[:i])": durations[:i] is kaam se pehle wale kaamon ke time hain; sum un ka jor hai, yani is kaam ka intezar.
"print(tasks[i], "waits", wait, ...)": kaam ka naam, intezar, aur khatam hone ka waqt (wait + apna time).
"print("All tasks done at", sum(durations), "s")": saare kaamon ka kul time.
Output: "Print report waits 0 s, finishes at 3 s", "Save file waits 3 s, finishes at 4 s", "Send email waits 4 s, finishes at 6 s", aur "All tasks done at 6 s".
Khud try karein: durations = [1, 2, 3] kar ke Run karein: ab Save file 1 s aur Send email 3 s intezar karega, lekin kul time phir bhi 6 s rahega.

blocks.prompt: Computer ke job scheduling system mein queue ka concept (idea) kaise lagta hai (short question 6)?
blocks.explanation: Har aane wala job queue ke peeche enqueue hota hai. Jab processor ya printer free (khali) ho, scheduler sab se aage wala job dequeue kar ke chalata hai. Is tarah jobs aane ke order mein chalte hain (pehle aao, pehle pao), koi job reh nahi jata, aur sab ke saath barabar (fair) kaam hota hai.

items: Task scheduling: kaam aaye to enqueue, computer tayyar ho to dequeue; pehle aao, pehle pao.
